name: User Registration Notification
description: Notifies roles and / or email addresses about user account events (create / update / delete).
project_description:
Notifies delegated roles and custom users about new user registrations.

 
 Allows admin notifications to roles or custom e-mail address 
 Allows changing the 'from' address 
 Allows adding custom 'reply-to' address 
 Settings can change all core account setting e-mail templates 
 Allows you to send emails on user create/update/delete to your delegated users 
 Allows selection of e-mail message types that will be altered 
 Allow customization of Core hidden Admin (pending admin approval) e-mail 
 
 Back to top 

 Drupal 7 only: 
 The Drupal 7 version will only receive important bug fixes, no further features. 

 Modules you may use together 
 
 User Settings Access allows delegated users to grant permissions to other users. But the delegated users will not receive any notifications about new users as they are not site admins. User registration notification fills this gap. 
 
 Supporting modules 
 
 Token module 
 Entity module for [user:status] token
